As of this writing, Strategy holds 840,447 BTC, worth more than $72 billion. The company has nearly $9 billion in unrealized losses on its Bitcoin holdings.
Saylor’s comments came after Bitcoin rebounded in the second half of August, rising to $80,000. The cryptocurrency has gained 23% in the past month.
